steps.note: Pairs start at even indices before the single element and at odd ones after it. Check the pair at an even mid.
arr[4] ≠ arr[5] — the pattern is already broken, so the single one is at 4 or left of it.
arr[2] ≠ arr[3] — the pattern is already broken, so the single one is at 2 or left of it.
arr[0] = arr[1] — a pair starts at an even index, so the single one is further right.
Range closed on position 2: 2 is the element that appears once. O(log n) instead of XOR-ing everything.
